notes: Fixes the playback speed control silencing the audio. With Clip Guard turned on, picking any speed stopped the sound completely while the player carried on showing that it was playing - and the same stall could hit the end of a track or episode. Clip Guard holds a few milliseconds of audio in hand to catch peaks before they arrive, so it has a tail to flush whenever a stream is drained; it was flushing that tail over and over instead of once, so the drain never finished and nothing further reached the speakers. Also fixes a buffer of audio being dropped mid-playback when Auto EQ's analysis and a fresh output buffer landed on the same moment. Improved: the playback speed picker now shows for on-device music and videos in the Media Player, not only for YouTube - a speed stays in force until you change it, so picking 1.5x for a video used to leave the next song playing fast with no control on screen to put it back.
